bettermounthudport.configuration.title: Better Mount HUD Settings
bettermounthudport.configuration.showFoo: Keep the hunger bar visible while riding a mount with hearts. The mount's hearts move above it.
bettermounthudport.configuration.showExp: Show the experience bar and level while riding a horse, camel or other jumping mount. The jump bar comes back while you hold the jump key.
bettermounthudport.configuration.showJum: Keep the jump bar visible while the mount's jump is on cooldown (for example, the camel's dash).
